name: holistic-linting
description: Discovers and runs repository-configured quality gates for requested or changed work, preserves diagnostics as evidence, routes non-trivial failures to available causal/domain capabilities, verifies correction integrity, and reports unresolved or out-of-scope findings without silently weakening gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run configured quality gates and verify corrections without hiding diagnostics.
interface.longDescription: Discovers and runs repository-configured quality gates for requested or changed work, preserves diagnostics as evidence, routes non-trivial failures to available causal/domain capabilities, verifies correction integrity, and reports unresolved or out-of-scope findings without silently weakening gates.
defaultPrompt: Run the repository's configured quality gates for the requested or changed scope and verify any corrections.
